title: An auditory "low road" for threat processing in humans sensitive to fast temporal cues.
summary: Rapid threat processing is a fundamental and evolutionarily conserved function of the brain. In vision, influential models of emotion propose the existence of a fast subcortical pathway for threat processing, connecting the visual thalamus with the amygdala, driven by coarse visual inputs. In audition, whether such a "shortcut" operates in humans has remained unknown. Here, using psychophysiology and neuroimaging, we provide convergent human evidence for an auditory pathway that is sensitive to fast temporal acoustic cues, previously linked to salient alarm signals and coarse auditory processing. Threatening sounds with fast temporal cues elicited rapid neural and autonomic responses at early post-stimulus latencies. Notably, right amygdala responses to these cues covaried with individual differences in strength of a direct auditory thalamo-amygdala pathway. Together, these findings identify a previously uncharacterized "low road" for auditory threat processing in humans, and establish fast temporal acoustic structure as a key feature supporting rapid affective responses.

标题：人类对快速时间线索敏感的声音威胁加工“低通路”
摘要：快速的威胁加工是大脑一项基本且进化上保守的功能。在视觉领域，有影响力的情绪模型提出存在一条用于威胁加工的快速皮层下通路，连接视觉丘脑与杏仁核，并由粗略的视觉输入驱动。在听觉领域，这种“捷径”是否在人类中运作仍属未知。本研究结合心理生理学与神经影像学方法，提供了汇聚性的人类证据，支持一条对快速时间声学线索敏感的听觉通路，该通路此前被认为与显著的警报信号和粗略听觉加工有关。带有快速时间线索的威胁性声音在刺激后早期潜伏期即可诱发快速的神经和自主神经反应。值得注意的是，右侧杏仁核对这些线索的反应与个体在直接听觉丘脑-杏仁核通路强度上的差异共变。总之，这些发现识别出一条此前未被表征的人类听觉威胁加工“低通路”，并确立了快速时间声学结构作为支持快速情感反应的关键特征。
关键词：威胁加工；听觉低通路；杏仁核；快速时间线索；情绪神经科学
